as_told.title: FOIA to NNSA on Starfish Prime UFO records

plain: Someone used FOIA, a US law that lets anyone request government records, to ask the National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA), the agency that runs America's nuclear weapons work, for every record about UFOs, UAP (the government's newer term for unidentified objects) or any related acronym from the Starfish Prime series of US nuclear tests. Michels brings this up on three episodes and says the requester was anonymous. In one he quotes the reply from June 2022: "It was determined that an additional review of your case by the subject matter expert with jurisdiction regarding responsive records was required." The letter sends the request on to an expert for review and treats it as having a holder with authority over "responsive records", but it does not say what those records are or whether any of them concern UFOs.
